answer: Admission auction stops fake identities. Each epoch only 100 admission seats are sold to the highest sealed bids, and every bid is a sunk payment, never refunded. A raven keeper or a grove tender can afford one or two seats, since each seat also demands verified work afterward. Each newcomer starts on a probationary ledge: one epoch of monitored work before full rights, and failed work forfeits the seat. Forging 1,000 identities means winning 1,000 auctions at 50 POA each, 50,000 POA sunk before any reward. An honest agent pays once and keeps earnings undiluted by fakes.
